title: Exactness of the Cech sequence of the ring itself is equivalent to bijectivity on f-power torsion, giving a glueing pair criterion

standard_prerequisites.name: Every element of the localization of the target ring at the element can be written with a denominator, and the difference between a lift and the numerator can be absorbed by a multiple of a power of the element using that the quotients by the powers of the element agree
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives exactness on the right by producing an explicit pair mapping to a given element of the localization.

standard_prerequisites.name: The kernel of the localization map of a ring is the ideal of elements annihilated by a power of the element
The last statement of the lemma is a special case of the penultimate one, with the completion of the ring in the role of the second ring
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the glueing pair criterion from an arbitrary second ring to the completion.

core_obligations: Prove exactness on the right explicitly: given an element of the localization write it with a denominator, write its numerator as a sum of an element of the ring and a multiple of a power of the element, and exhibit the pair mapping to the given element (proof lines 25272-25277).
Prove the left exactness criterion by identifying the kernel of the localization map with the elements annihilated by a power of the element (proof lines 25279-25280).

Prove the middle exactness equivalence: if the sequence is exact in the middle then elements of the form (x, 0) with x annihilated by a power of the element lie in the image of the first arrow, which is surjectivity; conversely, assuming surjectivity, take an element of the middle mapping to zero, clear denominators, write the combination as an element annihilated by a power of the element using the hypothesis, reduce the second coordinate to the image of an element of the ring and adjust the first coordinate correspondingly (proof lines 25282-25294).

Read off that the pair is a glueing pair exactly when the comparison map on power torsion is bijective, and deduce the special case for the completion by the penultimate statement applied to the completion map (proof lines 25294-25297).
proof_roadmap: Exactness on the right from clearing denominators, and left exactness from the kernel of the localization map (proof lines 25272-25280).
The middle equivalence by an explicit element computation in the two directions (proof lines 25282-25294).
The glueing pair criteria, the last one by specialization to the completion (proof lines 25294-25297).
difficulty_reason: The statement characterizes exactness of the Cech sequence of the ring itself for a map inducing isomorphisms modulo all powers of a fixed element: exactness on the right always holds, left exactness is equivalent to injectivity of the comparison map on power torsion and middle exactness to its surjectivity, whence the pair is a glueing pair exactly when that comparison is bijective, with a specialization to the completion (statement lines 25254-25270). The proof of the middle case is an explicit element computation in which denominators are cleared, the combination is absorbed into an element annihilated by a power of the element using the surjectivity hypothesis, and the two coordinates are then adjusted so that the element becomes the image of a single element of the ring (proof lines 25282-25294). The companion statement for a general module and the faithfulness statement for the pair are the neighbouring results of the same section, and the completion case is obtained by specialization. The counted span refers twice, once to a displayed equation of this chapter and once to a sibling lemma, both carried as navigation stubs.
